subject: Pricing hypothesis & short extension request
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@orchardai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + pricing hypothesis / ask for short extension

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the clear run-through of the Orch-Indexer flow and the live latency targets. Quick recap + asks so everything is aligned: 

Summary from call:
- Target production volume: roughly 10–15M tokens/month (initial ramp).
- Primary workload: synchronous chat with 1.5–2k tokens per session peak, median ~450 tokens.
- Budget band indicated on the call: $10k–$15k/month (still awaiting procurement confirmation).

Our pricing hypothesis and economics: 
- Expected unit: $/1M tokens range we think is realistic: $800–$1,100 depending on concurrency and latency SLOs.
- If you hit ~12M tokens/month, that implies ~$9.6k–$13.2k/month at the above band.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the internal budget band (PO runway) and whether $10k/mo is the target?
2) Procurement timing — when can we expect a PO or formal SOW?
3) To avoid interrupting your experiments, we can grant a short credit extension while you finish procurement. Would you need 2 weeks or 1 month?

I attached the usage export you shared (orchardai-usage-report.csv) and my proposed safety-net amount for a short bridge.

If you want, we can also spin up a Dedicated capacity estimate to show the delta vs hosted for your workload.

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben in for pricing if we need a one-off concession.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: orchardai-usage-report.csv (CSV)
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@orchardai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + pricing hypothesis / ask for short extension

Thanks Dylan — helpful summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Budget: finance verbally signed off on a $12k/mo runway but procurement needs a PO to lock it in.
- Tokens: the 10–15M window is correct for month 1 post-launch; sprint weeks could spike to ~20M.
- Extension ask: a 2-week cushion would be ideal while procurement finalizes the PO.

One additional ask — can you confirm what a $900/1M token rate would look like in absolute monthly spend at 12M tokens (ballpark)? We want to validate with finance.

Also cc'ing Ethan (ops) who will own the onboarding.

— Sarah

Subject: Re: Recap + pricing hypothesis / ask for short extension

Dylan —

Thanks for the thread. Quick internal: finance will approve a small pilot credit as a bridge if we keep it timeboxed and attach a MAP that includes PO date and expected token thresholds. Proposed terms from my side: 
- Credit: 750k tokens (equivalent pricing allowance — see back-of-envelope at $900/1M => ~$675 credit).
- Extension: 14 days from approval.
- Condition: PO or SOW expected within the 14-day window; otherwise credit will be paused.

If Ben signs off on an escalation or larger concession we can expand but we should hold to the MAP condition. I attached a short approval stub for legal to reference.

Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot-credit-approval-stub.pdf (PDF)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@orchardai.com>, Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@orchardai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + pricing hypothesis / ask for short extension

Sarah + Ethan —

Appreciate the quick response and the PO timing color. To answer your quick finance question: at $900 per 1M tokens, 12M tokens/month ~ $10,800/month (12 * $900). That sits inside the $10k–$15k band you called out.

We can do the following as an operational plan: 
- Bridge credit: 750k tokens granted immediately once you confirm via reply to this thread.
- Extension length: 14 calendar days.
- MAP (mutual action plan) we propose to include: 
  * Target PO submission date: 2026-08-30
  * Technical onboarding checkpoint: 2026-08-25 (integration smoke tests)
  * Billing contact and SOW sign-off: procurement contact + PO on file by 2026-08-30

Attachment: proposed-safety-net-credit.pdf (PDF) — contains the exact conditions and fallback.

If that works, reply with a one-line confirmation and we’ll issue the credit and send a short DocuSign for the MAP acknowledgement.

Best,
Dylan
Attachment: proposed-safety-net-credit.pdf
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@orchardai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@orchardai.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + pricing hypothesis / ask for short extension

Thanks — confirmation here. OrchardAI accepts the 750k token bridge and the 14-day extension, and we’ll target PO submission by 2026-08-30.

We’ll plan for the 8/25 integration checkpoint — Ethan will coordinate availability. Please send the DocuSign/map and the credit stub and we’ll countersign.

— Sarah
